title: Re-orientation brief
description: Write a short re-orientation brief capturing the current state of polyglot-pdf after a ~4-month gap. Covers: architecture (frontend <-> WebSocket <-> FastAPI <-> Gemini Live, stateless client/sessionStorage), the new claude-swarm-kit workflow (beads cadence, 3-tier docs, /closeout, promotion feature->dev->main), and the three drift areas (doc disorganization, AI model/pricing drift, stale TODO.md). Read-only; output is a journal entry.

title: Fix undefined MODEL_LIVE/MODEL_LABELING crash; make models env-swappable
description:
backend/config.py Settings defines only MODEL_NATIVE, but backend/main.py:59-61 (/health) and backend/dependencies.py:17 reference settings.MODEL_LIVE and settings.MODEL_LABELING -> AttributeError today. Add MODEL_LIVE and MODEL_LABELING, all os.getenv-backed (mirror USE_JIT_SCHEMA/FORM_KITS_* pattern), giving an A/B knob (MODEL_NATIVE=gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview, no redeploy). Decide whether to keep or drop the /health 'labeling' key (normalizer is deprecated). Do early; no deps.

Acceptance: GET /health returns 200 with all referenced model names populated; uvicorn boots clean.
close_reason: Added MODEL_LIVE + MODEL_LABELING to Settings, all three model fields os.getenv-backed (env-swappable, no redeploy). /health returns 200 with all model names populated; uvicorn boots clean; 111 tests pass. Kept /health labeling key as a knob (normalizer deprecated but acceptance lists it).

title: AI model + pricing refresh (swappable, A/B-able)
description: Modernize the Gemini model layer: fix the latent /health crash (undefined MODEL_LIVE/MODEL_LABELING), make model selection env-swappable, key pricing by model family so 2.5 vs 3.1 can be A/B'd in live testing, clean up the deprecated 2.5-pro reference, and update docs. See plan Phase 3.

Build docs/INDEX.md as the canonical map listing every planned component + standards doc with a one-line 'load when' and entry-point files. This bead defines the structure that the content beads (B2-B15) fill in.

Acceptance: CLAUDE.md lean and scannable; INDEX lists all planned tier-2 docs; check_doc_freshness.py passes for tier-1.

title: Documentation reorganization (3-tier progressive discovery)
description: Restructure ~63 md files / ~13k lines into the swarm-kit 3-tier system. Tier 1 = only universal rules (CLAUDE.md + INDEX). Tier 2 = hybrid: ~6 coarse component docs (per surface) + focused standards docs (per cross-cutting concern). Decompose the two canonical docs (planning_documents/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md 375L, planning_documents/TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md 1494L) into the tiers, write each canonical fact once, then archive the originals. Preserve scar tissue (CRITICAL/BUG comments) into the matching component docs. See plan Phase 1.

title: Fix pricing table + family-keyed cost calc
description:

Make pricing a dict keyed by model family (2.5-native, 3.1-live) with verified rates (2.5: 0.50/3.00/2.00/12.00; 3.1: 0.75/3.00/4.50/12.00 per 1M text-in/audio-in/text-out/audio-out). Thread active model name into the cost calc (backend/adapters/live_ai_gemini.py:1134-1263, backend/utils/token_file_logger.py) so it selects the right rate row. Correct the comment + add a real 'Updated:' stamp. Depends on D1 (env-swappable model in place).

Acceptance: unit test asserts a known token count yields the 2.5 rate and the (different) 3.1 rate.
